about: Composite progress for `score:<n>` goals: the game's own rewards. Sum of weight x (signal now - signal when the judge started): XP earned (1 per XP), gear (800 per +1 average item level over the 17 slots) and wealth (2 per copper of money plus vendor value of everything owned). The run's score is (overall rate + best 15-minute window rate) / 2 in progress points per hour. Other signals are reported but not scored.
